name: php-baremetal/ext-slate
description: Slate for php-baremetal: a retained-mode 2D scene graph and compositor for display panels, with a software graphics layer. Platform-neutral.

slate-effects.description: Graphic effects compiled into Slate; an effect left out is not built and the PHP API that uses it throws.

slate-debug.description: Builds Slate's profiler: frames per second on screen and a line of timings per second on the console.
